rationale: User-directed design change during Stage 7 feature verification: the inline cost-center affordance must become a dropdown that lists existing cost centers to link, with an inline 'Create Cost Center' action in the dropdown panel footer, matching the IntegrationSelectDropdown pattern. This intentionally OVERRIDES sub-task AC5 and parent story AC3 ('not a general picker for choosing among existing cost centers') per explicit user decision; spec and ticket will be updated to record the scope change.

findings.problem: The cost_center attribution affordance is a single 'Create Cost Center' button. Per the user's explicit decision it must instead be a dropdown (select) that lists existing cost centers to link, with an inline 'Create Cost Center' action in the dropdown panel footer — consistent with the integration-select dropdown pattern in src/pages/assistants/components/AssistantForm/components/Toolkits/IntegrationSelectDropdown.tsx.
findings.recommendation:
Rework ChargebackSettings and its host wiring:

1) ChargebackSettings.tsx props: replace `linkedCostCenterName?: string` with `selectedCostCenterId?: string`, add `costCenterOptions: FilterOption[]` (from '@/types/entity/...' FilterOption used by Select; getCostCenterOptions returns this shape) and `onSelectCostCenter: (id: string | undefined) => void`. Keep `onCreateCostCenter` and `canEdit`.

2) When chargeback_attribution === 'cost_center', render `Select` from '@/components/form/Select' with: options={costCenterOptions}, value={selectedCostCenterId}, placeholder='Select cost center', showClear={canEdit}, disabled={!canEdit}, onChange calls onSelectCostCenter(e.target.value), and panelFooterTemplate rendered only when canEdit = a secondary Button with <PlusSvg/> + 'Create Cost Center' that calls onCreateCostCenter (mirror IntegrationSelectDropdown's panelFooterTemplate exactly, including its classes). This preserves 'create inline' while now also allowing selection of an existing cost center.

3) UnifiedProjectBudgetModal.tsx: add an independent useEffect (do NOT touch the load-bearing budget-scaling effect ordering / interactionInitRef / prevHardsRef, and keep the CR-001 seed effect keyed on the open transition) that, when isChargebackFeatureEnabled && canManageBudgets && visible, fetches costCentersStore.getCostCenterOptions() into state (handle failure quietly with a toast or empty list). Merge the currently linked cost center {label: linkedCostCenter.name, value: linkedCostCenter.id} into the options if absent so its label renders. Pass costCenterOptions, selectedCostCenterId={linkedCostCenter?.id}, and onSelectCostCenter to ChargebackSettings. onSelectCostCenter(id): if id, resolve the option label -> setLinkedCostCenter({id, name}); if undefined (cleared) -> setLinkedCostCenter(null). Keep the CR-002 chargebackMissingCostCenter guard and the CR-003 clear_cost_center behavior; selecting an existing center sets linkedCostCenter.id and satisfies the guard, and the save flow already PATCHes cost_center_id.

4) Keep the inline create flow (useInlineCostCenterCreate + CostCenterFormPopup) exactly as is; the footer 'Create Cost Center' still calls inlineCostCenter.open, and onCreated still links the new center and selects it.

5) Tests (TDD, keep all green + pre-commit gate, no --no-verify): rework src/pages/settings/administration/components/__tests__/ChargebackSettings.test.tsx — the cost_center branch now renders a combobox/dropdown listing the provided cost center options and exposes a 'Create Cost Center' action in the panel footer; selecting an option calls onSelectCostCenter with its id; when a center is selected its label shows as the value; controls are disabled when canEdit=false. Update ChargebackSettings.inlineCreate.test.tsx so the 'Create Cost Center' trigger is reached via the dropdown panel footer (open the dropdown first). Update src/pages/settings/administration/components/__tests__/UnifiedProjectBudgetModal.chargeback.test.tsx to mock costCentersStore.getCostCenterOptions and cover selecting an existing cost center as well as the create-inline path. Remove/replace the earlier 'no combobox' and plus-icon-button assertions that no longer hold.

Note in code comments that the existing-cost-center picker is intentional per the updated requirement (supersedes the earlier 'no picker' constraint).
